View Name - ev_ty
Description Compatibility view that allows queries to continue to work against ev_ty 
View Definition
Oracle Definition Sql Server Definition 
create or replace view ev_ty 

(ag_id, alarm_lev, assign_case_state, 

auto_response, can_dispatch, case_num_id, 

cbtime1, cbtime2, days_avail, disp_req, 

e_u_type, eng, loi_dist, majevt_id, 

msg, near_dist, page_id, priority, 

resp_plan_name, sub_eng, sub_tycod, 

time1, time1_def, time2, time3, time4, time5, 

tycod, fs_icode, fs_icodemessage,

fs_rcode, fs_rcodemessage,

intercadsend,additional_events)

as

select

et.ag_id, etal.alarm_lev, 

assign_case_state, auto_response, 

'F', -- can_dispatch

case_num_id, 

initial_callback_timer, --cbtime1 

repeat_callback_timer, --cbtime2

days_avail, disp_req, 'E', eng, loi_dist, majevt_id, 

etal.msg, near_dist, page_id, priority, 

etal.resp_plan_name, sub_eng, 

case when et.sub_tycod = 'default' then NULL 

   else et.sub_tycod end,

pending_timer, -- time1

pending_timer_default, -- time1_def

dispatch_timer, -- time2

enroute_timer, -- time3

arrive_timer, -- time4

acknowledge_timer, -- time5

et.tycod,

fs_icode,

fs_icodemessage,

fs_rcode,

fs_rcodemessage,

intercadsend,

additional_events

from event_type et 

	join event_type_alarm_level etal 

	on et.tycod = etal.tycod and 

	et.sub_tycod = etal.sub_tycod and 

	et.ag_id = etal.ag_id

UNION ALL 

select

ag_id, 

0, -- alarm_lev 

0, -- assign_case_state 

'T', -- auto_response 

can_dispatch, 

NULL, -- case_num_id 

0, -- cbtime1 

0, -- cbtime2 

0, -- days_avail

'N', -- disp_req 

'U', -- e_u_type

eng, 

NULL, -- loi_dist

NULL, -- majevt_id

NULL, -- msg

NULL, -- near_dist 

NULL, -- page_id

9, -- priority 

NULL, -- resp_plan_name

NULL, -- sub_eng 

NULL, -- sub_tycod 

alert_timer, -- time1 

0, -- time1_def

0, -- time2

0, -- time3

0, -- time4

0, -- time5

oos.tycod,

NULL, -- fs_icode

NULL, -- fs_icodemessage

NULL, -- fs_rcode

NULL, -- fs_rcodemessage

NULL, -- intercadsend,

NULL -- additional_events

from out_of_service_type oos 

	join out_of_service_type_agency oos_ag

	on oos.tycod = oos_ag.tycod

UNION ALL

select 

ag_id, 

0, -- alarm_lev 

0, -- assign_case_state 

'T', -- auto_response 

'F', -- can_dispatch

case_num_id, 

0, -- cbtime1 

0, -- cbtime2 

0, -- days_avail

'N', -- disp_req 

'D', -- e_u_type

eng, 

NULL, -- loi_dist

NULL, -- majevt_id

NULL, -- msg

9, -- priority

NULL, -- sub_eng

NULL, -- sub_tycod 

0, -- time1 

0, -- time1_def

0, -- time2

0, -- time3

0, -- time4

0, -- time5

tycod,

NULL, -- fs_icode

NULL, -- fs_icodemessage

NULL, -- fs_rcode

NULL, -- fs_rcodemessage

NULL, -- intercadsend

NULL -- additional_events

from disposition_type 

          
create view ev_ty 

(ag_id, alarm_lev, assign_case_state, 

auto_response, can_dispatch, case_num_id, 

cbtime1, cbtime2, days_avail, disp_req, 

e_u_type, eng, loi_dist, majevt_id, 

msg, near_dist, page_id, priority, 

resp_plan_name, sub_eng, sub_tycod, 

time1, time1_def, time2, time3, time4, time5, 

tycod, fs_icode, fs_icodemessage,

fs_rcode, fs_rcodemessage,

intercadsend,additional_events)

as

select

et.ag_id, etal.alarm_lev, 

assign_case_state, auto_response, 

'F', -- can_dispatch

case_num_id, 

initial_callback_timer, --cbtime1 

repeat_callback_timer, --cbtime2

days_avail, disp_req, 'E', eng, loi_dist, majevt_id, 

etal.msg, near_dist, page_id, priority, 

etal.resp_plan_name, sub_eng, 

case when et.sub_tycod = 'default' then NULL 

   else et.sub_tycod end,

pending_timer, -- time1

pending_timer_default, -- time1_def

dispatch_timer, -- time2

enroute_timer, -- time3

arrive_timer, -- time4

acknowledge_timer, -- time5

et.tycod,

fs_icode,

fs_icodemessage,

fs_rcode,

fs_rcodemessage,

intercadsend,

additional_events

from event_type et 

	join event_type_alarm_level etal 

	on et.tycod = etal.tycod and 

	et.sub_tycod = etal.sub_tycod and 

	et.ag_id = etal.ag_id

View Name - multi_response_view
Description This view is used to provide additional data to the MFC monitors in the form of custom columns pulled from a config id. Customers may choose to use a different view or they may alter this view if they need additional columns in the monitors. Note that this view is not used by the WPF monitors. 
View Definition
Oracle Definition Sql Server Definition 
create or replace view multi_response_view as

 (select agency_event.num_1, 

 agency_event.multi_event_id, 

 agency_event.is_open,

 trans_des.origin_location as origin, 

 trans_des.location as destination 

 from agency_event left outer join trans_des 

 on agency_event.num_1= trans_des.num_1

 where agency_event.eid != 0) 

          
create view multi_response_view as

 (select agency_event.num_1, 

 agency_event.multi_event_id, 

 agency_event.is_open,

 trans_des.origin_location as origin, 

 trans_des.location as destination 

 from agency_event left outer join trans_des on 

 agency_event.num_1= trans_des.num_1

 where agency_event.eid != 0)

Entity Type Name - ActiveStationEmployee
Description Personnel who are currently logged on to a station. Station personnel can be explicitly logged on via the logon station personnel command, or implicitly logged on when personnel are assigned to a unit via logon unit or unit properties, and that unit is associated with a station. When a station person is assigned to a unit, the unit id can be found in the act_persl table. Added for CR 1-4UUSDH 
Base Table Name act_station_persl
View Name cmvActiveStationEmployee
Monitored Yes
Properties
Property Name Base Column Data Type NULL Access Type Description
DelayValue
[default = 0] 		delay_value int32  no  readOnly  Delay, in minutes. Amount of time it would take this person to get to the station. 
Description description string(200)   yes  readWrite  Description or comment 
EmployeeId
[Monitored] 		empid int32  no  readOnly  Employee id 
LogonMethod logon_method int32  no  readOnly  The method by which the person was logged on to the station. 0= Logged on implicitly by Logon Unit or Unit Properties. 1= Logged on explicitly by dispatcher using Logon Station Personnel command.  
LogonTime logon_dts dateTimeOffset  no  readOnly  Logged on timestamp 
RecommendedUnitId recommended_unid string(10)   yes  readOnly  Unit for which the employee has been recommended. Recommend Unit will set this column.  
StationId
[Monitored] 		station string(10)   no  readOnly  Station id 
Status
[Monitored] 		status int32  no  readOnly  Current status. 0= available, 1= unavailable (due to a break or other temporary reason), 2= unavailable because the person is currently assigned to a unit, 3 = unavailable because Recommend Unit has recommended this person for a unit (recommended_unid contains the recommended unit id).  
StatusTime status_dts dateTimeOffset  no  readOnly  Time when person changed to current status.

Entity Type Name - ActiveUnitDevice
Description Act_device stores devices associatated with logged on units, unit personnel, and unit vehicles. When units are logged on, the devices such as GPS Device, and radio alias may be pulled from def_device (or lineup_device if logging on units from a lineup), or the user can manually override the device information. MDT Server should be the only application that inserts, updates or deletes MDT ID rows. When signing on people to units, the person's defined devices, such as HT Radio, can be pulled from def_device/ lineup_device or manually overridden by the user. I/Tracker updates the location fields in this table, and CAD can update the other fields. The history information for the location fields is in un_hi_device_loc and the history of changes to the other device columns is in un_hi_device. CR 1-6PGD42: PLT  
Base Table Name act_device
View Name cmvActiveUnitDevice
Monitored No
Properties
Property Name Base Column Data Type NULL Access Type Description
Altitude altitude double  yes  readOnly  Distance above mean sea level (+ above) 
Bearing bearing double  yes  readOnly  Clockwise angle from true North range [0, 360.0] 
Description description string(50)   yes  readWrite  Description 
DeviceAlias device_alias string(20)   yes  readWrite  User-friendly alias name for device 
DeviceId device_id string(40)   no  readOnly  Unique device id for the specified device type. For MDTs and SMTs, the device ID must be a positive integer. For radios mounted in a vehicle, this may be the radio alias. For hand held radios, this may be the radio id. This may also be a GUID or UUID received from an external system 
DeviceSubtypeCode
[default = 0] 		device_sub_type int16  no  readOnly  Qualifier on the device type. Used when CAD system has interfaces to multiple external systems of the same type, such as multiple RADIO systems, each of which may have its own set of unique ids. The cad DeviceSubType parameter table defines the valid sub-types for each device type, and it maps the sub-type numbers to a configurable name. 
DeviceTypeCode device_type int16  no  readOnly  Device type. 0 = Unknown, 1 = Other, 2 = GPS Device, 3 = Radio Alias, 4 = HT Radio, 5 = SMT, 6 = MDT. The cad DeviceType parameter list maps the device type number to a configurable display name 
FixAge fix_age int16  yes  readOnly  Code for age of fix when this location was recorded (not the current age of the data). 0=unknown, 1=10 seconds or greater, 2=less than 10 seconds 
FixType fix_type int16  yes  readOnly  GPS source (fix type) indicator. 0=2D, 1=3D, 2=2D-differential, 3=3D-differential, 6=dead reckoning, 8=degraded, 9=unknown/invalid 
GpsDate gps_date string(8)   yes  readOnly  Date of last GPS data from the device, in YYYYMMDD format  
GpsProtocol
[default = 0] 		gps_protocol int16  no  readOnly  GPS protocol. I/Tracker uses the GPS protocol to know how to communicate with the device. The cad DeviceGpsProtocol parameter table defines the valid GPS protocols 
GpsTime gps_time int32  yes  readOnly  Time of last GPS data from the device, stored in seconds since midnight UTC 
HorizontalPrecision horizontal_precision int16  yes  readOnly  Horizontal dilution of precision: 1=ideal, 2-3=excellent, 4-6=good, 7-8=moderate, 9-20=fair, 21-50=poor 
IpAddressAndPort apcdata string(64)   yes  readWrite  IP Address and port last received by the MDT Server from the Client 
IsMasterMdt
[default = false] 		is_master_mdt boolean  no  readOnly  From MDT Server's perspective, is this the master device for this unit? 1= Master device, 0= Not master device. 
IsTrackable
[default = false] 		is_trackable boolean  no  readOnly  Is device trackable? 0 = False, 1 = True

Entity Type Name - ActiveUnitEmployeeDevice
Description Act_device stores devices associatated with logged on units, unit personnel, and unit vehicles. When units are logged on, the devices such as GPS Device, and radio alias may be pulled from def_device (or lineup_device if logging on units from a lineup), or the user can manually override the device information. MDT Server should be the only application that inserts, updates or deletes MDT ID rows. When signing on people to units, the person's defined devices, such as HT Radio, can be pulled from def_device/ lineup_device or manually overridden by the user. I/Tracker updates the location fields in this table, and CAD can update the other fields. The history information for the location fields is in un_hi_device_loc and the history of changes to the other device columns is in un_hi_device. CR 1-6PGD42: PLT

Entity Type Name - ActiveUnitHistory
Description This table contains a history of everything that has happened to all the units in the system. When data in the active unit's child tables act_persl or act_device is modified (other than location data), CAD records a new change id, and writes the latest personnel and device history, as well as unit history. The un_hi_child_change_id identifies a set of un_hi_persl and un_hi_device records, that are valid for one or more un_hi records.

Monitored No

Properties

View Name cmvAgencyEventTypeResponse
Monitored No
Properties
Property Name Base Column Data Type NULL Access Type Description
AgencyEventSubtypeCode
[default = default] 		sub_tycod string(16)   no  readOnly  The sub-type of the event type. 'default' if not specified 
AgencyEventTypeCode tycod string(16)   no  readOnly  Event type code 
AgencyId ag_id string(9)   no  readOnly  Agency Id. Different agencies may have different type information for the same event type. For example, police might respond to a murder with priority 1, but EMS may respond with a priority of 3 
AlarmLevel
[default = 0] 		alarm_lev int32  no  readOnly  Alarm Level. This defines the alarm level for the event type. The value must be greater than or equal to 0. 
IncidentCode fs_icode string(4)   yes  readOnly  The incident code that will be added to the ZIR protocol packet. If the ZIR protocol version is Westnet Firstin 11, this string must be exactly four characters long Examples: I001, I004, I250, etc. Or if the ZIR protocol version is Westnet Firstin 8, this string must be exactly three characters long Examples: I01, I04, or I99, and the 'I' must be capitalized. Each I- code maps directly to a specific type code (tycod)  
IncidentCodeDesc fs_icodemessage string(50)   yes  readOnly  A description of the incident code. Examples: structure fire, animal bite, toxic waste spill, etc. This field cannot be longer than 50 characters 
InterCadAdditionalEvents additional_events string(80)   yes  readOnly  InterCAD column, a coded ASCII string with event type and sub type

PagerId page_id string(12)   yes  readOnly  Pager ID or Pager Group ID. If the page_id is not specified in the esz table, I/Page will look for the page_id in this table. I/Page sends notifications to this page identifier when new events are created with the specified agency, event type, sub-type and alarm level.  
ResponseCode fs_rcode string(4)   yes  readOnly  The response code that will be added to the ZIR protocol packet. Each R-code corresponds to a specific severity level. If the ZIR protocol is Westnet Firstin 11, this string must be exactly four characters long. Examples: R001, R004, R250, etc. Or if the ZIR protocol is Westnet Firstin 8, this string must be exactly two characters long. Examples: R1, R4, or R8, and the 'R' must be capitalized. R-codes are mapped to a valid alarm level and tycod combination. If there are identical fs_icode entries, they will have different R-Code combinations.  
ResponseCodeDesc fs_rcodemessage string(60)   yes  readOnly  A description of the R-Code. This field cannot be longer than 60 characters 
ResponsePlanName resp_plan_name string(50)   yes  readOnly  Response plan which will be used when an event of this type is created. 
UnitRecommendMessage msg string(80)   yes  readOnly  Message. This column is information specific of the event type to be displayed at time of unit recommendation.

Entity Type Name - ApplicationDispatchGroupAccess
Description This table stores information about application access to agency/ dispatch groups. Dispatcher, Calltaker, CADDBM and the Recommend Unit Service restrict access based on the terminal node running the application. NetViewer, NetDispatcher and NetCommander restrict access based on the employee running the application.

View Name cmvApplicationDispatchGroupAcc
Monitored No
Properties
Property Name Base Column Data Type NULL Access Type Description
AgencyId ag_id string(9)   no  readOnly  Agency ID. Contains the agency id of the dispatch group.

CurrentAccess
[default = N] 		current_access string(1)   no  readOnly  Current Access: Contains a C (cover), R (read), W (Write) if this application type and access are signed on for the user. N means no access. L means terminal is 'locked' by the Change Operator command. Old lflag column 
CurrentAccessSaved current_access_saved string(1)   yes  readOnly  Saved value of current_access column. The Change Operator command in CAD sets current_access_saved to current_access, and then sets current_access to L to indicate terminal is locked. Value is NULL when app is not in Change Operator mode.

[default = N] 		current_visibility string(1)   no  readOnly  Current Visibility. Column is set to 'L' for loaded but not visible, 'Y' for loaded and visible or 'N' for not loaded. Old currassign column 
DefaultAccess
[default = R] 		default_access string(1)   no  readOnly  Default access. Defines whether the user may monitor (R) events and units of an agency/ dispatch group or update (W) them or (C) cover them. For the Recommend Unit Service, (R) is not used, (W) means units in agency/dgroups with this access level will be considered for recommendations, but events will be ignored and (C) means events in agency/dgroups with this access level will have recommendations generated, and units in agency/dgroups with this access level will be considered for recommendations. Entity Type Name - CallInfo
Description This table holds the information regarding calls that came in via the phone system. 
Base Table Name call_info
View Name cmvCallInfo
Monitored No
Properties
Property Name Base Column Data Type NULL Access Type Description
CallDirection call_direction int16  no  readWrite  The direction of the call. 0 - "U" Don't know. Data not available, 1 - "I" Incoming Internal call, 2 - "E" Incoming External call, 3 - "O" Outgoing call  
CallId call_id string(20)   no  readOnly  The key for the call  
CallLink call_link string(20)   yes  readWrite  This will usually be NULL. If a call is queued and a client answers it before the server is able to assign a number to it, the client will create a call_data record. If it then gets notification from the server that the server has assigned a number, it puts the server assigned number in the call_link field. In this case, the call will have two call_data records and the second one will be linked to the first one.  
CallType call_type int16  no  readWrite  The type of the call. Valid values are: Text - 0, Voice - 1, Alarm - 2, RadioTalk - 3  
CalledPhoneNumber called_phone string(20)   yes  readWrite  Called number  
CallerPhoneNumber caller_phone string(20)   yes  readWrite  Caller's number  
ConversationExpireTime conversation_expire_dts dateTimeOffset  yes  readWrite  Time after which the conversation is no longer available from the vendor 
ConversationId conversation_id string(40)   yes  readWrite  Refers to a conversation file.

CreatedTime cdts dateTimeOffset  no  readOnly  Creation time 
IsEmergency is_emergency boolean  no  readWrite  1 if this call is an emergency call, else 0 
IsWireless is_wireless boolean  no  readWrite  1 if this call is a wireless call, else 0

Entity Type Name - CommonEventLvSession
Description This table stores location verify (LV) choices presented to the user during event creation. When the user enters an address in CAD, CAD may display location verify dialogs, asking the user for more information. CAD stores the address originally submitted by the user, plus the list of location verify addresses offered by CAD. If a user modifies an event's location on the main event information dialog, CAD will record the subsequent LV exchanges as a separate LV session. This table is only populated if you turn on the EnableLVSessionLog parameter in the cad GeneralDetails parameter list. Added for CR1-4HLEEQ.  
Base Table Name lv_session
View Name cmvCommonEventLvSession
Monitored No
Properties

CommonEventId eid int32  no  readOnly  Event id 
SessionData session_data string(Max)   no  readOnly  Location verify session data. For Intergraph Development use only. 
SessionId session_id guid  no  readOnly  Unique session id

Entity Type Name - DefinedDevice
Description Def_device stores the defined devices for units, vehicles and people. Defined devices may include MDTs, GPS devices such as AVLs, vehicle-mounted radios (radio aliases), and HT radios. CR 1-6PGD42: PLT  
Base Table Name def_device
View Name cmvDefinedDevice
Monitored No
Properties
Property Name Base Column Data Type NULL Access Type Description
AgencyId ag_id string(9)   yes  readOnly  Agency ID. If owner = 3, the agency that owns this device, else null. 
Description description string(50)   yes  readOnly  Device description 
DeviceAlias device_alias string(20)   yes  readWrite  User-friendly alias name for device 
DeviceId device_id string(40)   no  readOnly  Unique device id for the specified device type. For MDTs and SMTs, the device ID must be a positive integer. For radios mounted in a vehicle, this may be the radio alias. For HT radios, this may be the radio id. This may also be a GUID or UUID received from an external system 
DeviceSubtypeCode device_sub_type int16  no  readOnly  Qualifier on the device type. Used when CAD system has interfaces to multiple external systems of the same type, such as multiple RADIO systems, each of which may have its own set of unique ids. The cad DeviceSubType parameter table defines the valid sub-types for each device type, and it maps the sub-type numbers to a configurable name. 
DeviceTypeCode device_type int16  no  readOnly  Device type. 0 = Unknown, 1 = Other, 2 = GPS Device, 3 = Radio Alias, 4 = HT Radio, 5 = SMT, 6 = MDT. The cad DeviceType parameter list maps the device type number to a configurable display name 
EmployeeId empid int32  yes  readOnly  If owner = 1, employee that owns this device, else null 
GpsProtocol
[default = 0] 		gps_protocol int16  no  readOnly  GPS protocol. I/Tracker uses the GPS protocol to know how to communicate with the device. The cad DeviceGpsProtocol parameter table defines the valid GPS protocols  
IsTrackable is_trackable boolean  no  readOnly  Is device trackable? 0 = False, 1 = True 
IsTrackingDeviceForOwner tdevice_for_owner boolean  no  readOnly  Specifies if this device is used as the tracking device for the owner. 1= True, 0 = False 
Owner owner int16  no  readOnly  Owner. 0 = unit, 1 = employee, 2 = Vehicle, 3 = Agency 
UnitId unid string(10)   yes  readOnly  If owner = 0, the unit that owns this device, else null 
VehicleId carid string(12)   yes  readOnly  If owner = 2, vehicle that owns this device, else null

I/CAD updates the app_type, logged_on, ldts, lodts and term columns when the user logs on. The pswrd and pass_date columns are updated when the user changes his/her password.

Entity Type Name - FireStationAlert
Description The fs_alert table contains the alert address, station, bay and alert order information for all alertable units. Each row represents an individual unit at a fire station, at a particular alert order. Each unit id (unid) in cd_units to be alerted should correspond to a station and bay in fs_alert. If the primary address is unreachable, an alert will be sent to the alternate address 
Base Table Name fs_alert
View Name cmvFireStationAlert
Monitored No
Properties
Property Name Base Column Data Type NULL Access Type Description
AlertAddress alert_address string(24)   no  readOnly  Contains the address for alertable units. Unique for each station/bay/type/alert_order combination. Format varies for each controller. 
AlertOrder
[default = 1] 		alert_order int32  no  readOnly  Order in which to alert this address. 1 = Primary, 2 = Alternate  
Bay bay string(3)   no  readOnly  Represents an individual bay in each fire station. Used to map individual units to an alert address that is defined in the fs_alert table 
ControllerType type string(10)   no  readOnly  Type of controller. Current possible values include: CENTRACOM, FRAP, LOCUTION, MODBUS, MOSCAD, PAGER, WESTNET, ZETRON, and ZETRONXML. If type = PAGER, then this must be an alternate alert address (alert_order = 2) 
StationId station string(10)   no  readOnly  Unit's station

Entity Type Name - MapStreet
Description This table contains all unique street names. Note that two different streets do not have different entries if they have the same name, but are located in separate municipalities. Rows with virtualcode ='F' are generated by map data. Rows with virtualcode='T' may be generated by CADDBM. A row with virtualcode = T' may have the same feature name, feature type, direction prefix and direction suffix as a real row with virtualcode='F'. 
Base Table Name st_cd
View Name cmvMapStreet
Monitored No
Properties
Property Name Base Column Data Type NULL Access Type Description
AliasedStreetId alias int32  yes  readOnly  Alias Text ID. If this name is an alias for another street, the text_id of that street is stored in this field. Otherwise the field is NULL. The field is set when a street is assigned an alias. 
DirectionPrefix dirpre string(2)   yes  readOnly  Direction Prefix. The direction prefix, N, NW, SE, and so on. 
DirectionSuffix dirsuf string(2)   yes  readOnly  Direction Suffix. The direction suffix, N, NW, SE, and so on. 
IsVirtual virtualcode boolean  no  readOnly  If virtualcode = 'T', then this is a virtual st_cd record with no link to the segme, cd_edge or cd_node tables. Instead, this row links to record(s) in sp_ad. If virtualcode = 'F', then this is a normal st_cd record. 
MapStreetId text_id int32  no  readOnly  Text ID. The text_id is a unique identifier assigned to each street name which is equal to the "text_id" column in the segme table. 
Soundex soundex string(4)   yes  readOnly  Soundex Code. The soundex code for the feature name. 
StreetName feanme string(30)   yes  readOnly  Feature Name. Stores the name of the street. 
StreetType featyp string(4)   yes  readOnly  Feature Type. Stores the feature type. For example, road or street.

Monitored No
Properties

DeviceSubtypeCode
[default = 0] 		device_sub_type int16  no  readOnly  Qualifier on the device type. Used when CAD system has interfaces to multiple external systems of the same type, such as multiple RADIO systems, each of which may have its own set of unique ids. The cad DeviceSubType parameter table defines the valid sub-types for each device type, and it maps the sub-type numbers to a configurable name.

CreateAevenViewWithCustomCols both Rather than simply using the static delivered view definition, create or replace the view with the custom columns included. 
CreateEventViewWithCustomCols both Rather than simply using the static delivered view definition, create or replace the view with the custom columns included.  
CreateMapView both Create one map view, given the table name and view name. CR 1-5LXDSV: Create MAP A/B views with specific columns 
CreateMapViews both Create map views, based on views listed in map_views. This procedure creates the appropriate views on a live database and a map staging database. CR 1-5LXDSV: Create MAP A/B views with specific columns 
get_parameter_value sqlServer Returns a parameter value based on the given set name, list name, parameter name, and override list 
pcsGetChange both The procedure pcsGetChange returns a change record. pcsGetChange reads and deletes from the change_record table, which acts as a FIFO queue. Triggers populate the change_record table. pcsGetChange is called from the Change Publisher Service. Input: wait_time_sec: Number of seconds to wait for data to arrive in table Output: status: Status of operation. 0 = success, 1 = timeout expired change_id: Change identifier change_data: Formatted XML describing change error_str: unused max_age_minutes: Only return data that is newer than this many minutes old. Change Publisher throws away data older than this limit, so don't bother passing it to Change Publisher. Defaults to 10 minutes 
pcsPurgeChangeRecords both Purge records from the change_record table. A job calls this procedure. Parameters: deleteRowsOlderThanMinutes number default 60: Delete rows older than this number of minutes batchIntervalRows number default 10000: Delete (and commit in Oracle) in batches of this size sleepIntervalSeconds number default 1: Sleep this many seconds in between each batch of deletes. 
pcsRecordChange both Record a change by inserting a row into the change_record table. The Change Susbscription triggers call this procedure. 
PurgeConnTransCount both This procedure is called by the purge conn_trans_count job, to periodically remove old records from the conn_trans_count table. Parameter deleteRowsOlderThanHours must be 7 days (7 * 24 hours) or more.

create_ag_com_event_temp_lock_checks oracle Optionally, create certification constraints which ensure that when the application issues a commit, temp_lock is set to F in agency_event and common_event. This prevents events from disappearing because they are locked. The CAD DB Utility doesn't fully support deferred constraints, which is why we use an anonymous block. 
create_service oracle Create CADDB service. I/CAD applications will connect to the primary database using this service. This service is a critical component of the Data Guard client failover solution.

grant_dictionary_permission oracle Specifically grant select any dictionary privilege to cad owner, so that Data Guard startup and shutdown triggers work properly. Cad user should already have this permission via a role, but the triggers require that the user be specifically granted this permission. 
GrantPrivsToCadUserRole oracle If the database is setup to use a different Oracle login for the user and owner, grant permissions to the cad_user_role on any new objects that this file has created.

setup_purge_change_records_job both Setup job to purge old change records. The job runs every hour and purges records older than 1 hour. In the SQL Server version, the job is created for the current database on the local server, and the job is owned by the current login.  
setup_purge_conn_trans_count_job both Setup job to purge old conn_trans_count records.
